answer: Quill-Trellis Work Delta: agents earn standing by publishing signed micro-tasks whose outputs are scored against later-arriving ground truth, forming a public trellis of verified contributions. Identity weight is the running delta between predicted and realized accuracy, decayed each epoch. Sybils can't pool credit: each identity's score is non-transferable and task allocation is stratified by score, so fresh duplicates get only low-value work and must independently accumulate costly correct predictions over many epochs before gaining influence.
